literal: Muzong, Part Two
idiomatic: Muzong, Part Two

literal: In the fourteenth year, on the wuyin new moon of the first month of spring, the spirit canopy was installed and enshrined.
idiomatic: In the fourteenth year, on the wuyin new moon of the first spring month, the spirit canopy was installed and enshrined.

literal: On wuxu day Han sent urgent word that Song generals were coming to attack.
idiomatic: On wuxu day Han sent an urgent report that Song generals were marching to attack.

literal: In the second month, on renzi day, an edict ordered Southwest Pacification Commissioner Talie to advance troops to aid Han.
idiomatic: In the second month, on renzi day, an edict directed Southwest Pacification Commissioner Talie to march in relief of Han.

literal: On guihai day he went to the Huang River.
idiomatic: On guihai day the Emperor went to the Huang River.

literal: On wuchen day the deer-keepers Moda, Haili, and five others were dismembered in the wild; earth was piled to mark the place.
idiomatic: On wuchen day seven deer-keepers, including Moda and Haili, were dismembered in the open country, and mounds of earth were raised to mark the spot.

literal: On jisi day he went to Old Forest East Marsh.
idiomatic: On jisi day the Emperor went to Old Forest East Marsh.

literal: On renshen day Han reported defeating Song troops at Shizhou.
idiomatic: On renshen day Han reported a victory over Song forces at Shizhou.

literal: In the fourth month of summer, on dingsi day, Han sent envoys to give thanks for repelling the Song army.
idiomatic: That summer, in the fourth month on dingsi day, Han sent envoys to thank the court for driving back the Song army.

literal: That month sweet dew fell at Huanglong Prefecture.
idiomatic: That month sweet dew descended at Huanglong Prefecture.

literal: In the fifth month he shot salt-licking deer at White Eagle Mountain, continuing for nearly ten days.
idiomatic: In the fifth month he hunted salt-licking deer at White Eagle Mountain for nearly ten days straight.

literal: In the sixth month, on the bingwu new moon, he hunted at Jade Mountain and forgot to return for the whole month.
idiomatic: On the bingwu new moon of the sixth month he hunted at Jade Mountain and did not return for the entire month.

literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on renchen day, wine and dried meat were used to sacrifice to Black Mountain.
idiomatic: That autumn, in the seventh month on renchen day, the Emperor sacrificed wine and dried meat to Black Mountain.

literal: In the eighth month, on yisi day, he went to Miaozi Ridge and called deer to be shot.
idiomatic: In the eighth month, on yisi day, he went to Miaozi Ridge, called up deer, and shot them.

literal: Four deer were taken; the gamekeepers Nügui and others were rewarded with gifts according to rank.
idiomatic: Four deer were taken, and the gamekeepers Nügui and others received graded rewards.

literal: On dingwei day he returned to the palace.
idiomatic: On dingwei day the Emperor returned to the palace.

literal: On wushen day his birthday fell on a heaven-sent amnesty; he declined congratulations and granted a partial amnesty to prisoners in the capital.
idiomatic: On wushen day his birthday coincided with a heaven-sent amnesty; he refused congratulations and granted a partial amnesty to prisoners in the capital.

literal: On yimao day prisoners were reviewed.
idiomatic: On yimao day the Emperor reviewed prisoners.

literal: In the ninth month the Yellow Shiwei rebelled.
idiomatic: In the ninth month the Yellow Shiwei rose in rebellion.

literal: In the tenth month of winter, on bingwu day, the attendant Wuguzhe presented polished stone and was granted two hundred fifty taels of white gold.
idiomatic: That winter, in the tenth month on bingwu day, the attendant Wuguzhe presented polished stone and received two hundred fifty taels of white gold.

literal: On bingchen day Zhanglu Shensi replaced Wolli as zhassaji and was granted a gold belt, a gold cup, and two hundred taels of silver.
idiomatic: On bingchen day Zhanglu Shensi replaced Wolli as zhassaji and was given a gold belt, a gold cup, and two hundred taels of silver.

literal: Within his jurisdiction he held sole authority over offenses up to and including capital crimes.
idiomatic: Within his jurisdiction he held sole authority to punish every offense short of capital crime.

literal: In the eleventh month, on renwu day, at the winter solstice, he feasted and drank until dawn.
idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on renwu day, at the winter solstice, he feasted and drank until dawn.

literal: From then on he slept by day and drank by night.
idiomatic: From then on he slept through the day and drank through the night.

literal: He killed the attendant Xiao Liu within the forbidden palace.
idiomatic: He killed the attendant Xiao Liu inside the inner palace.

literal: In the twelfth month, on bingwu day, a black rabbit was sacrificed to the spirits.
idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on bingwu day, a black rabbit was sacrificed to the spirits.

literal: The Wugu rebelled and plundered the people's property and livestock.
idiomatic: The Wugu rebelled and plundered civilian property and livestock.

literal: Xiangwen Sengyin fought them and was defeated; Sengyin, Yishi, and others died.
idiomatic: Xiangwen Sengyin gave battle and was routed; Sengyin, Yishi, and others were killed.

literal: In the fifteenth year, on yimao day of the first month of spring, Palace Secretariat Commissioner Yalisi was made campaign commander-in-chief and Tiger Army xiangwen Chusi was made campaign deputy commander; three hundred Tulubu troops were added, and forces from the various tribes were combined to suppress the rebels.
idiomatic: In the fifteenth year, on yimao day in the first spring month, Palace Secretariat Commissioner Yalisi was made campaign commander-in-chief and Tiger Army xiangwen Chusi campaign deputy commander; three hundred Tulubu troops were added, and combined forces from the tribes were sent to suppress the rebellion.

literal: Ziboleidi, son of the Wugu yilijin, alone did not rebel, and an edict praised him.
idiomatic: Ziboleidi, son of the Wugu yilijin, alone did not rebel, and an edict commended him.

literal: That month the Old Man star appeared.
idiomatic: That month the Old Man star appeared.

literal: In the second month, on the renyin new moon, there was a solar eclipse.
idiomatic: On the renyin new moon of the second month the sun was eclipsed.

literal: The Emperor went east on a tour; on jiayin day, because ducks had been taken, the hawkery punishments of facial tattooing and waist-cutting were remitted and corvée duties were restored.
idiomatic: The Emperor traveled east; on jiayin day, because ducks had been taken, the hawkery punishments of facial tattooing and waist-cutting were remitted and corvée duties were restored.

literal: That month the Wugu killed their chief Sulidi; the remainder surrendered and then rebelled again.
idiomatic: That month the Wugu killed their chief Sulidi; the survivors surrendered and then rebelled again.

literal: In the third month, on guiyou day, the attendant Dong'er presented chopsticks at the wrong moment and was stabbed to death by the Emperor's own hand.
idiomatic: In the third month, on guiyou day, the attendant Dong'er presented chopsticks at the wrong moment, and the Emperor stabbed him to death with his own blade.

literal: On dingchou day the great Yellow Shiwei chieftain Yinniji rebelled.
idiomatic: On dingchou day the great Yellow Shiwei chieftain Yinniji rose in rebellion.

literal: On guiwei day forty households of Wufang people defected to the Wugu.
idiomatic: On guiwei day forty households of Wufang people defected to the Wugu.

literal: On guisi day the gamekeeper Shaladie missed his deadline while scouting geese; roasting-iron and iron-comb torture was added, and he died.
idiomatic: On guisi day the gamekeeper Shaladie missed his deadline scouting geese; roasting-iron and iron-comb torture were added, and he died.

literal: In the fourth month of summer, on yisi day, the lesser Yellow Shiwei rebelled; Yalisi, Chusi, and others attacked them but were defeated by the Shiwei, and envoys were sent to rebuke them.
idiomatic: That summer, in the fourth month on yisi day, the lesser Yellow Shiwei rebelled; Yalisi, Chusi, and others attacked them but were beaten by the Shiwei, and envoys were sent to rebuke them.

literal: On yimao day Tulii replaced Yalisi as commander-in-chief, Nügu was made army supervisor, and light cavalry were led forward to suppress the rebels; tamada Xunjili was also ordered to carry an edict summoning and persuading them.
idiomatic: On yimao day Tulii replaced Yalisi as commander-in-chief, Nügu was made army supervisor, and light cavalry were sent to suppress the rebels; tamada Xunjili was also ordered to carry an edict summoning and persuading them to submit.

literal: In the fifth month, on renshen day, Xunjili reported that persuasion had been refused.
idiomatic: In the fifth month, on renshen day, Xunjili reported that they refused to be persuaded.

literal: Yalisi, with Tartar and Su herd-guard troops, pursued them to Chai River and fought without success.
idiomatic: Yalisi, with Tartar and Su herd-guard troops, pursued them to Chai River and fought without success.

literal: On jiashen day Kuguzhi reported that Shiwei chief Yinniji had fled into Dilie territory.
idiomatic: On jiashen day Kuguzhi reported that Shiwei chief Yinniji had fled into Dilie territory.

literal: In the sixth month, on xinhai day, Yulugu presented fine horses and was granted two thousand taels of silver.
idiomatic: In the sixth month, on xinhai day, Yulugu presented fine horses and received two thousand taels of silver.

literal: Because the attendant Hulabi's horse had arrived first with the report, he was granted one thousand taels of silver.
idiomatic: Because the attendant Hulabi's horse had arrived first with the report, he received one thousand taels of silver.

literal: That month the Dilie came to surrender.
idiomatic: That month the Dilie submitted.

literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on jiaxu day, Yalisi reported that the Wugu had reached Hedeb Marsh and dispatched yilijin Huali and yilibi Changsi to attack them.
idiomatic: That autumn, in the seventh month on jiaxu day, Yalisi reported that the Wugu had reached Hedeb Marsh and dispatched yilijin Huali and yilibi Changsi to attack them.

literal: On dingchou day the Wugu plundered residents of Yulin Valley north of the Supreme Capital, and linya Xiao Wo was sent to suppress them.
idiomatic: On dingchou day the Wugu plundered residents of Yulin Valley north of the Supreme Capital, and linya Xiao Wo was sent to suppress them.

literal: On gengchen day Yalisi and the others fought the Wugu without success.
idiomatic: On gengchen day Yalisi and his forces fought the Wugu without success.

literal: In the tenth month of winter, on dingwei day, Changsi fought the Wugu and defeated them.
idiomatic: That winter, in the tenth month on dingwei day, Changsi fought the Wugu and routed them.

literal: In the twelfth month, on jiachen day, because the attendant Xige had returned home without permission, his wife was killed.
idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on jiachen day, because the attendant Xige had returned home without permission, his wife was put to death.

literal: On dingwei day the attendant Suilu was killed.
idiomatic: On dingwei day the attendant Suilu was killed.

literal: The court encamped at Black Mountain Pingdian.
idiomatic: The court made its quarters at Black Mountain Pingdian.

literal: In the sixteenth year, on the dingmao new moon of the first month of spring, he was drunk and declined congratulations.
idiomatic: In the sixteenth year, on the dingmao new moon of the first spring month, the Emperor was drunk and refused congratulations.

literal: On jiashen day he walked incognito through the market and rewarded a wine shop with silver and silk.
idiomatic: On jiashen day the Emperor walked incognito through the market and rewarded a wine shop with silver and silk.

literal: On yiyou day the attendant Baihai, the household servants Shanfu and Yalage, Palace Secretariat gate clerk Laogu, and tamada Shilu were killed.
idiomatic: On yiyou day the attendant Baihai, the household servants Shanfu and Yalage, Palace Secretariat gate clerk Laogu, and tamada Shilu were put to death.

literal: In the third month, on jisi day, he went east on a tour.
idiomatic: In the third month, on jisi day, the Emperor traveled east.

literal: On gengwu day ducks were taken; on jiashen day geese were taken; on both occasions he drank until dawn.
idiomatic: On gengwu day ducks were taken and on jiashen day geese were taken; on both occasions he drank until dawn.

literal: In the fifth month, on jiashen day, because the year was drought-stricken, he rowed a boat on a pool to pray for rain.
idiomatic: In the fifth month, on jiashen day, because the year was drought-stricken, he rowed a boat on a pool to pray for rain.

literal: When no rain came, he left the boat, stood in the water to pray, and rain fell shortly afterward.
idiomatic: When no rain came, he left the boat, stood in the water to pray, and rain fell shortly afterward.

literal: In the sixth month, on bingshen day, because Baihai's death had been undeserved, his family was granted silver and silk.
idiomatic: In the sixth month, on bingshen day, because Baihai had been killed without cause, his family received silver and silk.

literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on renwu day, officials were instructed: wherever the Emperor traveled, tall markers must be erected and the people forbidden to trespass; violators were to be sentenced to death.
idiomatic: That autumn, in the seventh month on renwu day, officials were instructed that wherever the Emperor traveled tall markers must be erected and the people forbidden to trespass, on pain of death.

literal: In the eighth month, on dingyou day, Han sent envoys presenting gold vessels and armor.
idiomatic: In the eighth month, on dingyou day, Han sent envoys with gold vessels and armor.

literal: In the intercalary month, on yichou day, he watched wild deer enter a herd of tame deer and drank on horseback until late afternoon.
idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on yichou day, he watched wild deer enter a herd of tame deer and drank on horseback until late afternoon.

literal: In the ninth month, on gengzi day, he held a Double Ninth feast and drank day and night without pause until renzi day before it ended.
idiomatic: In the ninth month, on gengzi day, he held a Double Ninth feast and drank day and night without pause until renzi day before it ended.

literal: On jiwei day the wolf-keeper Li was killed.
idiomatic: On jiwei day the wolf-keeper Li was killed.

literal: In the tenth month of winter, on gengchen day, the ruler of Han was in mourning for his mother, and envoys were sent with condolence gifts.
idiomatic: That winter, in the tenth month on gengchen day, the ruler of Han was in mourning for his mother, and the Emperor sent envoys with condolence gifts.

literal: In the twelfth month, on jiazi day, he visited the wine-server Bilege's home, then visited Palace Front Inspector Yelü Yilage's residence and feasted for days on end.
idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on jiazi day, he visited the wine-server Bilege's home, then visited Palace Front Inspector Yelü Yilage's residence and feasted for days on end.

literal: He granted a gold basin, fine brocade, and one hundred pregnant mares; many attendants received offices.
idiomatic: He granted a gold basin, fine brocade, and one hundred pregnant mares, and many attendants received offices.

literal: On wuchen day Han sent envoys to pay tribute.
idiomatic: On wuchen day Han sent tribute envoys.

literal: That winter the court encamped at Black Mountain Pingdian.
idiomatic: That winter the court made its winter quarters at Black Mountain Pingdian.

literal: In the seventeenth year, on the gengyin new moon of the first month of spring, linya Xiao Wo and langjun Yelü Xianshi returned from suppressing the Wugu; the Emperor took Xianshi's hand, granted him a cup of wine, and appointed him right Pishi xiangwen.
idiomatic: In the seventeenth year, on the gengyin new moon of the first spring month, linya Xiao Wo and langjun Yelü Xianshi returned from suppressing the Wugu; the Emperor took Xianshi's hand, granted him a cup of wine, and made him right Pishi xiangwen.

literal: Yalisi, Chusi, and Xiali were granted sour thin wine to humiliate them.
idiomatic: Yalisi, Chusi, and Xiali were given sour thin wine to humiliate them.

literal: On yimao day yilibi Guyü presented Wugu captives.
idiomatic: On yimao day yilibi Guyü presented Wugu captives.

literal: In the second month, on jiazi day, Gao Xun memorialized that Song generals were fortifying Yijin Pass and asked that a flanking force be sent to harass them; the Emperor assented.
idiomatic: In the second month, on jiazi day, Gao Xun reported that Song generals were fortifying Yijin Pass and asked that a flanking force be sent to harass them; the Emperor assented.

literal: In the fourth month of summer, on wuchen day, the hawk-keeper Dilu was killed.
idiomatic: That summer, in the fourth month on wuchen day, the hawk-keeper Dilu was killed.

literal: On bingzi day he shot the willow branch to pray for rain and again poured water over the ministers.
idiomatic: On bingzi day he shot the willow branch to pray for rain and again drenched the ministers with water.

literal: In the fifth month, on xinmao day, the deer-keeper Zhage was killed.
idiomatic: In the fifth month, on xinmao day, the deer-keeper Zhage was killed.

literal: On renchen day Northern Chancellery Chancellor Xiao Haili died; court was suspended and the Double Fifth feast was canceled.
idiomatic: On renchen day Northern Chancellery Chancellor Xiao Haili died; court was suspended and the Double Fifth feast was canceled.

literal: In the sixth month, on jiwei day, the pheasant-keepers Shouge and Nianggu were dismembered and forty-four deer-keepers were killed.
idiomatic: In the sixth month, on jiwei day, the pheasant-keepers Shouge and Nianggu were dismembered and forty-four deer-keepers were put to death.

literal: That summer the court encamped at Tan.
idiomatic: That summer the court made its quarters at Tan.

literal: In the eighth month of autumn, on xinyou day, his birthday, because Chief Councillor Abudi was gravely ill, he declined congratulations.
idiomatic: That autumn, in the eighth month on xinyou day, his birthday, because Chief Councillor Abudi was gravely ill, the Emperor declined congratulations.

literal: In the ninth month, from the bingxu new moon, he hunted at Black Mountain and Red Mountain until the month ended.
idiomatic: In the ninth month, from the bingxu new moon, he hunted at Black Mountain and Red Mountain until the month ended.

literal: In the tenth month of winter, on yichou day, the wine-server Cuini was killed.
idiomatic: That winter, in the tenth month on yichou day, the wine-server Cuini was killed.

literal: In the eleventh month, on xinmao day, the attendant Yanshou was killed.
idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on xinmao day, the attendant Yanshou was killed.

literal: On renchen day the pig-keepers Abuzha, Helu, Zhulizhe, and Nielikuo were killed.
idiomatic: On renchen day the pig-keepers Abuzha, Helu, Zhulizhe, and Nielikuo were put to death.

literal: On gengzi day the Observatory reported that the moon should have been eclipsed but was not obscured; the Emperor took this as an auspicious sign and rejoiced in drink until dawn.
idiomatic: On gengzi day the Observatory reported that the moon should have been eclipsed but was not obscured; the Emperor took this as an auspicious sign and drank in celebration until dawn.

literal: On renyin day the deer-keepers Tangguo, Zhige, and Sala were killed.
idiomatic: On renyin day the deer-keepers Tangguo, Zhige, and Sala were put to death.

literal: In the twelfth month, on xinwei day, he personally killed the cook Haili and then butchered the body.
idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on xinwei day, he personally killed the cook Haili and then butchered the corpse.

literal: That winter the court encamped at Black River Pingdian.
idiomatic: That winter the court made its winter quarters at Black River Pingdian.

literal: In the eighteenth year, on the yiyou new moon of the first month of spring, he held a banquet in the palace and declined congratulations.
idiomatic: In the eighteenth year, on the yiyou new moon of the first spring month, the Emperor held a banquet in the palace and declined congratulations.

literal: On jihai day he viewed lanterns in the market.
idiomatic: On jihai day the Emperor viewed lanterns in the market.

literal: He spent one hundred taels of silver to buy wine, ordered the ministers to buy wine as well, and drank freely for three nights.
idiomatic: He spent one hundred taels of silver to buy wine, ordered the ministers to buy wine as well, and drank freely for three nights.

literal: In the second month, on yimao day, he visited Wufang Commissioner Xiashili's home and feasted until dawn.
idiomatic: In the second month, on yimao day, he visited Wufang Commissioner Xiashili's home and feasted until dawn.

literal: In the third month, on the jiashen new moon, he went to the Huang River.
idiomatic: On the jiashen new moon of the third month the Emperor went to the Huang River.

literal: On yiyou day swan-geese were taken and heaven and earth were sacrificed to.
idiomatic: On yiyou day swan-geese were taken and the Emperor sacrificed to heaven and earth.

literal: A great wine vessel was made, carved with deer patterns, named the Deer Urn, and filled with wine to sacrifice to heaven.
idiomatic: A great wine vessel was made, carved with deer patterns, named the Deer Urn, and filled with wine for the heaven sacrifice.

literal: On gengxu day the falconer Hutelu, the attendant Huage, and the prison guard Haili were killed; Haili's corpse was then mutilated.
idiomatic: On gengxu day the falconer Hutelu, the attendant Huage, and the prison guard Haili were put to death, and Haili's corpse was then mutilated.

literal: In the fourth month of summer, on the guichou new moon, the pig-keeper Chaolizhi was killed.
idiomatic: That summer, on the guichou new moon of the fourth month, the pig-keeper Chaolizhi was killed.

literal: On jisi day an edict ordered that attendants in the left and right retinues who showed talent, ability, and practical skill be promoted out of turn.
idiomatic: On jisi day an edict ordered that attendants in the left and right retinues who showed talent, ability, and practical skill be promoted without regard to seniority.
